# Lepons

> Lepons is a free desktop app (Windows, macOS) that is one cockpit for the AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, Cursor) on this PC and on every VM or server it reaches over SSH: sessions in panes with tabs, a workflow map of every machine's work, and a phone app (iPhone, Android) to watch and answer sessions.

- Download (Windows .exe, macOS .dmg, Android .apk): https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/releases/latest
- Guide (Korean): https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/blob/main/README.md
- Guide (English): https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/blob/main/README.en.md
- Privacy: https://lepons.app/privacy · Terms: https://lepons.app/terms · Support: https://lepons.app/support

## Key facts
- Desktop: up to eight panes; a pane holds one project's (machine and folder's) AI sessions, terminals and files as tabs. Files on this PC or a remote machine can be viewed and edited in place.
- Remote machines need only SSH; nothing is installed there. Sessions run in tmux and survive dropped connections. If tmux is missing, Lepons installs it in one click (sudo password asked in its own dialog, never saved).
- Workflow map (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M): a hub per machine with folders, sessions and subagents; always-visible summaries and a Goal / Progress / Now / Result card per session; "Needs you N" jumps to waiting sessions; focus mode on one branch; Follow mode; watch-only.
- Phone app: iPhone in App Store review (coming soon); Android as a direct APK from GitHub Releases, Google Play coming. Pairs by QR plus a six-digit check, signs in with a password and an authenticator (TOTP) code, connects through a relay (relay.lepons.app) with end-to-end encryption the relay cannot read. Notifications only for sessions waiting for input, coalesced, and not sent while the user is at the PC or in the app; an optional silent "all done". Notifications carry only the PC's name. The phone can answer and stop (Esc) but never quit an agent.
- Shows Claude and Codex plan usage (5-hour and 7-day limits) live; shows each machine's AI install and sign-in state and signs in on remote machines without a terminal.
- Sharing map: drag a folder onto another machine and its agents read and search it over MCP (read-only, secrets masked); work can be delegated to the owning machine.
- Optional desktop pet (produck) that shows which session is waiting for input.
